node.title: Re: Is Pod::Simple::Select a recommended replacement for Pod::Select? Or is there a better choice?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [mod://Pod::Usage] [https://metacpan.org/release/MAREKR/Pod-Usage-1.60/source/lib/Pod/Usage.pm#L32|used to] depend on [mod://Pod::Select], but was updated to depend only on [mod://Pod::Simple] when [mod://Pod::Parser] was deprecated (or rather, removed from core). So you could look at [https://metacpan.org/release/ATOOMIC/Pod-Usage-2.01/source/lib/Pod/Usage.pm#L254|how Pod::Usage now does it] (search the code for USAGE_SELECT), and I also have some simple code to pull sections out of POD (in this case verbatim sections) [https://github.com/haukex/Util-H2O/blob/99b3152f5617bfe9bf1b86bc4d4ce798ac21f11c/xt/author.t#L194|here].
